body:
@Szirle Thanks for the report.  I was able to reproduce this issue locally using the provided reproduction The issue reproduces on iOS 27.0 Simulator (iPhone 18 Pro) and Android 17 (API 37) Emulator and macOS 27.0. In each case, after reparenting the `ReorderableListView` during an active drag and dropping the item back at its original position, I observed:
```text
Null check operator used on a null value
```
The initial exception occurs in:
```text
SliverReorderableListState._itemOffsetAt
SliverReorderableListState._dragEnd
_DragInfo.end
```

I also observed subsequent `Null check operator used on a null value` exceptions after the drop during later rebuilds. This matches the reported behavior. routing to the `team-framework` for further investigation.
